title: 00 · Current welcome and entry boundary
sequence: Actual welcome → configured sign-in link / unavailable configuration. Clerk sign-in, verification and account menu are provider-owned gaps, not fabricated here.

title: 01 · Admission → invitation → workspace → setup
sequence: Create synthetic academy → review appointment → invitation/account entry → accept → select workspace → branch/sport/timezone → resume

title: 02 · Player registration and duplicate review
sequence: Directory → fictional player name → scoped possible duplicates → review → register → reopen profile

title: 03 · Guardian appointment and minimal access
sequence: Player → review exact link → invitation → acceptance → linked name/branch → end link

title: 04 · Trainer appointment and minimal profile
sequence: Staff → review branch scope → invitation → acceptance → own name/role/branch → end appointment

title: 05 · Draft programs and all dated sessions
sequence: Programs → weekdays and different times → full-period preview → prepare → pause/resume → confirm → dated list

title: 06 · Plan one date
sequence: Date → capacity → eligible Trainer/player candidates → roster changes → review → save → reopen

title: 07 · Plan a whole program atomically
sequence: Shared/weekday choices → preserve individual plans → review all → prepare → save all together → recovery

title: 08 · Publish → assigned Trainer schedule → withdraw
sequence: Review future planned dates → prepare/publish together → assigned schedule → own roster → withdraw before editing

title: 09 · Move/cancel a dated session
sequence: Private future date → old/new time and reason → conflict checks → confirm → retained history / cancellation

title: 10 · Online attendance and Owner correction
sequence: Authorized session → full roster → Present/Absent review → commit → Owner correction reason/history

title: 11 · Guardian linked-player schedule and attendance
sequence: Approved player → week/list/calendar → published session → own current attendance → access removed

title: 12 · Trainer requests an attendance correction
sequence: Saved mark → request/reason → Pending unchanged → Owner approve/reject → retained result/history

title: 13 · Player card, windows and automatic QR matching
sequence: Issue/replace/revoke card → scan windows → scoped scanner → one match / choose simultaneous match → duplicate protection

title: 14 · Reviewed development feedback and family publication
sequence: Draft → submit → return/revise → publish exact snapshot → Guardian public fields → withdraw/history
